rows.name: Additional Traits
rows.description: You have more traits than normal

rows.name: Arcane Blast
rows.description: You can convert any spell into an attack.

rows.name: Arcane Shield
rows.description: You can convert any spell into a defense.

rows.name: Arcane Talent
rows.description: Magic is in your blood, and at your fingertips.

rows.name: Aspect of the Beast
rows.description: Whether by magic or a curse of your blood, some part of you is more beast than man.

rows.name: Breadth of Experience
rows.description: Although still young for your kind, you have a lifetime of knowledge and training.

rows.name: Childlike
rows.description: Your resemblance to a human child tends to make others trust you, perhaps more than they should.

rows.name: Cloud Step
rows.description: Your tread is of unearthly lightness.

rows.name: Cooperative Crafting
rows.description: Your assistance makes item crafting far more efficient.

rows.name: Cosmopolitan
rows.description: Living in large exotic cities has put you in touch with many diverse civilizations, cultures, and races.

rows.name: Deep Drinker
rows.description: You draw greater amounts of ki from your libations.

rows.name: Deepsight
rows.description: Your senses are especially keen in the utter darkness.

rows.name: Diviner's Delving
rows.description: Your keen magical intuition makes reading signs, portents, and mystical clues quick and easy.

rows.name: Eagle Eyes
rows.description: Your vision is especially keen.

rows.name: Eclectic
rows.description: You have a talent for picking up different vocations.

rows.name: Elemental Focus
rows.description: Your spells of a certain element are more difficult to resist.

rows.name: Expanded Arcana
rows.description: Your research has revealed new spells.

rows.name: Extra Bombs
rows.description: You can throw more bombs per day.

rows.name: Extra Discovery
rows.description: You have made a new alchemical discovery.

rows.name: Extra Hex
rows.description: You have learned the secrets of a new hex.

rows.name: Extra Rage Power
rows.description: You have unlocked a new ability to use while raging.

rows.name: Extra Revelation
rows.description: You have discovered a new aspect of your mystery.

rows.name: Extra Rogue Talent
rows.description: Through constant practice, you have learned how to perform a special trick.

rows.name: Fast Drinker
rows.description: You swiftly guzzle spirits to draw forth ki.

rows.name: Fast Healer
rows.description: You benefit greatly from your healing, be it from spells or natural healing.

rows.name: Favored Defense
rows.description: Your cunning is your shield against your quarry's attacks.

rows.name: Fight On
rows.description: You can keep fighting even after you should be dead.

rows.name: Gnome Trickster
rows.description: Your arcane talents go beyond the illusory.

rows.name: Go Unnoticed
rows.description: Your small size lets you quickly duck out of sight.

rows.name: Greater Elemental Focus
rows.description: Choose an energy type to which you have already applied the Elemental Focus feat. Any spells you cast of this energy type are very hard to resist.

rows.name: Groundling
rows.description: You can speak with burrowing animals.

rows.name: Heroic Defiance
rows.description: You struggle on when others would fall.

rows.name: Heroic Recovery
rows.description: You can throw off the effects of crippling conditions.

rows.name: Improved Share Spells
rows.description: You can share spells with those you have a magical connection with.

rows.name: Improved Stonecunning
rows.description: Your sense for stonework is uncanny.

rows.name: Ironguts
rows.description: You have an especially strong stomach.

rows.name: Ironhide
rows.description: Your skin is thicker and more resilient than that of most of your people.

rows.name: Keen Scent
rows.description: Your nose is as sensitive as that of a wild predator.

rows.name: Leaf Singer
rows.description: Your songs recount the ways and mysteries of your people.

rows.name: Light Step
rows.description: You pick your way nimbly through even the most dangerous and uneven terrain.

rows.name: Lingering Performance
rows.description: The effects of your bardic performance carry on, even after you have stopped performing.

rows.name: Lucky Halfling
rows.description: You bring luck to those with whom you travel.

rows.name: Major Spell Expertise
rows.description: You can cast a single low-level spell as a spell-like ability.

rows.name: Master Alchemist
rows.description: Your mastery of alchemy is nearly supernatural.

rows.name: Minor Spell Expertise
rows.description: You are able to cast a 1st-level spell as a spell-like ability.

rows.name: Parry Spell
rows.description: You can throw an enemy spell back at its caster.

rows.name: Pass for Human
rows.description: You're easily mistaken for a human rather than a member of your own race.

rows.name: Racial Heritage
rows.description: The blood of a non-human ancestor flows in your veins.

rows.name: Raging Vitality
rows.description: While raging, you are full of vigor and health.

rows.name: Razortusk
rows.description: Your powerful jaws and steely teeth are deadly enough to give you a bite attack.

rows.name: Shared Insight
rows.description: You deftly direct others' attentions where you wish.

rows.name: Sharp Senses
rows.description: Your senses are especially sharp, even for your kind.

rows.name: Smell Fear
rows.description: You can catch the sour scent of fear on the wind.

rows.name: Sociable
rows.description: You have a way of helping others to get along.

rows.name: Spell Perfection
rows.description: You are unequaled at the casting of one particular spell.

rows.name: Spider Step
rows.description: Your physical mastery grants you an impossible stride.

rows.name: Steel Soul
rows.description: You are especially resistant to magic.

rows.name: Stone-Faced
rows.description: Rocks show more expression than you.

rows.name: Stone Sense
rows.description: You can feel movement in the very earth and stones around you.

rows.name: Stone Singer
rows.description: Your songs are in accordance with the ways and lands of your people.

rows.name: Summoner's Call
rows.description: Whenever you summon your eidolon, it is more powerful for a brief period of time.

rows.name: Taunt
rows.description: You may be small, but your remarks cut others down to size.

rows.name: Tenacious Transmutation
rows.description: Your mastery of the magic of changing makes your transmutations more durable.

rows.name: Verminheart
rows.description: You have a special bond with things that creep, crawl, skitter, and sting.

rows.name: War Singer
rows.description: Your songs draw upon the savage chants and brutal ways of your people, inspiring those around you to new heights of violence and savagery.

rows.name: Well-Prepared
rows.description: Somehow, you always seem to have the right tools or supplies close at hand.

rows.name: Blood of Heroes
rows.description: You have a sense of destiny about you and always seem to succeed, even when the odds are against you.

rows.name: Hero's Fortune
rows.description: Even at the start of your career, it was clear that you had a chance at greatness, and your legend continues to grow with every adventure.

rows.name: Luck of Heroes
rows.description: To others, it seems that you always have a bit of luck around you.
